answer: Keeping a fake identity out of this economy is arithmetic, not suspicion. Every claim is re-run by a random sample of peers, and a wallet that fails one audit forfeits the stake behind all its claims that epoch. Credit accretes the other way, slowly: one ferrous-weighted attestation at a time, so a thousand fresh keys still start at zero and each must wait its own echo of epochs before it can vote. An attacker then buys patience, not accounts, and the umber record of slashed wallets never washes off.
